name: RDDMS M27 CIMPL Preship (sample)
_comment: Secret-free template. Copy to RDDMS_M27_CIMPL_Preship.postman_environment.json (gitignored) and fill the empty secrets locally. In OSDU CI (CIMPL/AWS/GC) the platform injects access_token / ACCESS_TOKEN and points HOST at the target env, so the collection runs WITHOUT any secrets: the '0. Get Access Token' request auto-skips when a token is already present. Service URLs derive from {{HOST}} via Postman/Newman nested variable resolution, so you normally only change HOST (and KEYCLOAK_HOST for local self-mint).

values._comment: Base API host, no trailing slash. All service URLs below are {{HOST}}/api/... - override just this to retarget an environment.
Identity provider host for local ad-hoc self-mint only. Ignored in CI (platform injects access_token).
Bearer token. In CI the platform sets this (or ACCESS_TOKEN, aliased by the collection prerequest). When set, self-mint is skipped.
Group-suffix domain used to build data.default.owners/viewers ACL group names in the collection scripts.
Local ad-hoc self-mint only. Leave as-is; unused in CI (platform injects access_token).
Empty for public clients. Do NOT commit a real secret.
SECRET - fill locally only. Never commit. Not needed in CI.
